The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Partner Sales Manager to be a key contributing team member within the growing Dell alliances organization. Large OEM or Independent Hardware Vendor (IHV) brands - Dell, HPE, IBM, Lenovo, Ericsson, Cisco, Fujitsu and many more - are major partners for Canonical. These companies build software-defined solutions to capitalize on global open source mandates and associated macro trends. Canonical's flagship product, Ubuntu, and its broader open source portfolio are key ingredients for these partners to realize their aspirations. Canonical represents the best platform for rapid open source innovation.
Reporting to the Senior Director of Global Alliances - Dell, the Partner Sales Manager will work closely with Dell and Canonical teams in various geographies to enable Dell teams, generate and transact opportunities, drive a Canonical agenda within Dell, and achieve targeted results. They are responsible to build trusted relationships with Dell, increase Canonical market share and attach rate, evangelize the partnership and drive business interactions from across persona - from engineer to CxO. They will often run customer workshops focused on particular initiatives at that customer, attend sales events, give public presentations and participate in executive engagements as coordinated by the Senior Director.

  • Build strategic relationships and enable Dell teams on the partnership

  • Grow Dell's awareness of open source capabilities on Canonical Ubuntu

  • Deliver on targets, objectives and provide a voice of the partner

  • Align and support internal canonical field teams - identify, support, grow, transact

  • Team player with superior accountability and customer support skills
  • Credibility and working knowledge of Dell - its products, go-to-market motion, and field
  • Experience managing cross-functional teams and track record of operational excellence
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
  • Hands on experience with SalesForce.com and Google Suite a plus
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

  • Annual compensation review

  • Annual holiday leave

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

title: Junior Landscape Architecture Drafting Professional
description:
Junior Landscape Architecture Drafting Professional

Remote - Full Time - Worldwide

Who We Are: Join the M.Hudson Design Team

At M.Hudson Design, we are a dynamic, employee-focused company with 25 years of professional design experience. Built on the foundation of trust and open communication, we value our team above all. Our work environment integrates remote opportunities, allowing our employees to achieve a balanced and flexible work-life dynamic.

Our Core Values guide every decision we make and shape our culture: communication, empathy, discipline, greatness, collaboration, right, simplicity, and kindness. We strive to provide a world-class client experience before, during, and after the design process, ensuring both clients and employees feel valued and supported.

If you are passionate about landscape architecture and want to grow professionally, please read the posting carefully and follow the application instructions. Attention to detail is essential in our company.

We look forward to hearing from you!

What We Do at M.Hudson Design

We specialize in crafting landscape architecture experiences for high-end residential projects in South Florida, including multi-acre estate homes, waterfront estates, country club communities, and other upscale residences. Our services cover:

  • Landscape planting plans and detailed hardscape plans (driveways, pools, pool decks, patios, walkways, retaining walls, decks, docks, fencing, and gates)
  • Design of structural elements (columns, railings) to ensure functionality and aesthetics
  • Advanced irrigation, lighting, and drainage plans
  • 3D photo-realistic models, still images, and flythrough graphics

Sample plan sets are available to view by request as part of the application process. We are committed to delivering exceptional designs and are seeking passionate individuals to join our team.

Proprietary Design Process

We have developed a comprehensive residential design process supported by LiDAR site inventories and advanced drafting and graphics software. Our workflow emphasizes clear communication and alignment with clients throughout the project. Applicants may request a copy of our detailed design and drafting process outline as part of the application (restricted to applicants).

Our process helps us deliver projects on schedule while maintaining high standards and client satisfaction.

Job Description

As a Landscape Architecture Junior Drafting Professional, you will support the pre-design and preliminary design phases. In close collaboration with the Senior Drafting Professional and the design team, you will develop precise technical drawings and plans to establish a strong foundation for projects. Attention to detail and teamwork are essential to meet our high standards and vision.

This position offers the potential for performance bonuses based on team success. Details will be provided during the interview process. There is room for growth within the company, including promotion to Senior Drafting Professional to manage a drafting team and larger projects.

This role is hired as a freelance contractor, offering flexibility within a supportive, collaborative environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Developing pre-design deliverables, including the Survey Base Sheet, Inventory Base Sheet, Proposed Base Sheet, and Inventory Proposed Base Sheet to support project initialization.
  • Drafting schematic designs in collaboration with the design team using AutoCAD, Photoshop, and Illustrator.
  • Drafting preliminary designs while ensuring feasibility, aesthetics, and alignment with client vision.
  • Ensuring accuracy and compliance with local codes and regulations as directed by the design team.
  • Collaborating with team members to refine designs and advance project goals.
  • Updating drafts based on feedback and revisions to align with project standards.

This role offers growth opportunities within a dynamic team working on high-end residential projects.

Required

Qualifications & Skills:

  • Proficiency in AutoCAD; familiarity with Photoshop and Illustrator is a plus.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Foundational understanding of landscape architecture principles, especially for residential design.
  • Self-sufficiency and ability to manage deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred

  • Educational background in Landscape Architecture (undergraduate or graduate).
  • Experience in residential landscape architecture, particularly high-end or luxury projects.
  • Familiarity with Florida planting materials and regional considerations.

Experience Requirements

  • 1-3 years of experience drafting landscape plans in AutoCAD.

Work Environment

Remote work from a home office with a collaborative, communicative culture. We use Google Chat, email, and weekly Google Meet meetings to stay connected and aligned on goals.

Compensation & Benefits

Compensation is competitive with growth opportunities and performance-based incentives:

  • Hourly rate: $15-$25/hr based on experience
  • Minimum 3% annual inflation-based increase
  • Annual performance-based hourly increases
  • Annual performance bonus

We are committed to diversity and inclusion as part of our equal opportunity employer policy.

Diferenciais
